from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re,time
p=Path('/home/kubotak/projects/blackops');e=Path('.phpunit.cache/f5-orchestration/20261015');c=p/'.phpunit.cache/f2-orchestration/accepted-integration';h=c/'src/Internal/Audit/Authority/History'
start=time.perf_counter();source=(h/'AuditHistoryNativeGroup.php').read_text();scalar=(h/'AuditHistoryScalar.php').read_text()
rows={}
for tag,body in re.findall(r'^        (\d+) => \[(.*?)\],',source,re.M|re.S):
 fields={}
 for key,value in re.findall(r"'([A-Za-z0-9_]+)' => ('[^']*'|self::[A-Z_]+)",body):
  fields[key]={'self::OPTIONAL_FENCING':'?F','self::REQUIRED_FENCING':'F'}.get(value,value.strip("'"))
 assert fields
 rows[int(tag)]=fields
ints=set(re.findall(r"'([^']+)' =>",scalar.split('private const array INTEGER_BOUNDS = [',1)[1].split('\n    ];',1)[0]))
strings=set(re.findall(r"'([^']+)' =>",scalar.split('private const array STRING_KINDS = [',1)[1].split('\n    ];',1)[0]))
nullable=set(re.findall(r"'([^']+)' =>",scalar.split('private const array NULLABLE_KINDS = [',1)[1].split('\n    ];',1)[0]))
def primitive(kind):
 if kind=='null': return 'null'
 prefix=''
 if kind.startswith('?'):
  assert kind in nullable
  prefix='?';kind=kind[1:]
 assert kind=='B' or kind in ints or kind in strings,kind
 return prefix+('bool' if kind=='B' else 'int' if kind in ints else 'string')
routes=[];relation_tags=[]
for tags,owner,method in re.findall(r'([\d, ]+) => (AuditHistory\w+)::(\w+)\(\$admitted\)',source):
 tags=[int(x.strip()) for x in tags.split(',')];relation_tags+=tags
 helper=(h/f'{owner}.php').read_text()
 shapes={m:dict(field.strip().split(':',1) for field in shape.split(',')) for shape,m in re.findall(r'@param array\{([^}]+)\} \$v\s*\*/\s*public static function (\w+)',helper)}
 assert method in shapes,(owner,method)
 target=shapes[method]
 for tag in tags:
  actual={k:primitive(v) for k,v in rows[tag].items()};assert actual==target,(tag,actual,target)
 routes.append({'tags':tags,'callee':owner+'::'+method,'shapeMembers':len(target),'allSchemaRowsEqualHelperPrimitiveShape':True})
assert len(rows)==31 and len(routes)==15 and len(relation_tags)==20 and len(set(relation_tags))==20
alltags=[]
for name in ['AuditHistoryTag','AuditHistoryCheckpointTag','AuditHistoryControlTag']:
 value=(h/f'{name}.php').read_text();assert 'enum '+name+': int' in value
 alltags += [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'case \w+ = (\d+);',value)]
assert len(alltags)==50 and len(set(alltags))==50 and set(rows)<=set(alltags)
analyze=(p/e/'history-diagnostic-r2/analyze.log').read_text();errors=[]
for line_no,line in enumerate(analyze.splitlines(),1):
 if line.startswith('error['):
  m=re.search(r'argument #1 of `[^`]*\\(AuditHistory[^`]+)`',line);assert m,line
  errors.append({'line':line_no,'callee':m.group(1),'code':line.split(']:')[0][6:]})
assert len(errors)==15 and {x['callee'] for x in errors}=={x['callee'] for x in routes}
probe=json.loads((p/e/'history-type-flow-candidate/history-type-flow-probe-r1.json').read_text());capsule=[]
for receipt in probe['results']+[probe['switch']]:
 name=receipt['name'];inputs=probe['inputs'][name]
 loghash=hashlib.sha256(inputs['analyze.log'].encode()).hexdigest();sourcehash=hashlib.sha256(inputs['probe.php'].encode()).hexdigest()
 assert loghash==receipt['logSha256']
 assert sourcehash==receipt['inputSha256'],(name,sourcehash,receipt['inputSha256'])
 capsule.append({'name':name,'sourceHashMatches':True,'logHashMatches':True,'exit':receipt['exit'],'recordedSeconds':receipt['seconds']})
budget=json.loads((p/e/'history-type-flow-candidate/history-type-flow-budget-probe-r1.json').read_text())
for name,item in budget['files'].items():
 assert hashlib.sha256(item['content'].encode()).hexdigest()==item['sha256']
 assert len(item['content'].encode())==item['bytes']
for name,r in budget['records'].items():
 directory='switch_budget' if name=='switch-budget-receipt.json' else 'if_budget_control'
 for f,digest in r['files'].items(): assert budget['files'][directory+'/'+f]['sha256']==digest
check={'kind':'finite source text/schema comparison and retained capsule digest validation; no PHP/Mago/test execution','routes':routes,'nativeTagCount':len(rows),'relationTagCount':len(relation_tags),'relationCallSites':len(routes),'scalarOnlyTags':sorted(set(rows)-set(relation_tags)),'rejectedOtherEnumTags':sorted(set(alltags)-set(rows)),'actualAnalyzerErrors':errors,'syntaxCapsule':capsule,'budgetCapsuleEmbeddedHashesAllMatch':True,'bookkeepingWallSeconds':time.perf_counter()-start}
o=p/e/'history-type-flow-contract-review-r1-inputs.json';d=json.loads(o.read_text());d['mechanicalReview']=check;o.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
